text: I went to get a filling because of tooth sensitivity. I went twice. The first time, the dentist examined my tooth but couldn't find the cause, so they sent me for an X-ray. The results showed that I needed to be referred to a specialist, which required another appointment the next day. On the day of the specialist appointment, the doctor asked a lot of questions trying to find the cause. When they were about to start filling the tooth, they stopped after 2-3 tries and sent me for another X-ray. I thought to myself, "Didn't they already do an X-ray last time? It wasn't clear then. Why didn't they send me for an X-ray before filling the tooth?" I was a bit confused, but didn't think much of it. After the X-ray, the doctor said, "Didn't they already do an X-ray last time?" I was like, "Wait, didn't they share the information?" And while filling the tooth, they were talking to themselves, like they weren't sure about anything. (Is this really a specialist?) In short, after the procedure, the sensitivity was still there. One time was enough.
